title: Same ankle
summary: You go over on your ankle on the far corner of pitch two. The physio says two days off it; you want Saturday. A season on, same corner, same ankle.

ends.title: Told her straight
ends.text: You went over on the same ankle twice, and both times you limped straight to the physio.

ends.title: The same ankle
ends.text: You ran it off twice. The ankle has a click in it now.

beats.title: Over on it

event.title: Over on it
event.speaker: physio
setup: Small-sided game, far corner of pitch two, the dip by the drain. You go over on your right ankle and hear it before you feel it. {physio.name} is already walking over with the ice.

say: She presses on the outside of it and watches your face. "Ligament, not bone. Ice tonight, nothing on it for two days, then we'll see. Saturday's probably not happening."

replies.label: "Is there anything you can give me?"

say: "No. You can be stupid on Saturday if the gaffer lets you. I'm not helping."

rest.text: You sit out two days with your foot in a bucket. It's fine by Friday. You miss Saturday and the team draws.

played.text: The gaffer lets you. You play an hour on it strapped like a parcel and it swells up like a grapefruit on the coach home.

beats.hint: You went over on your ankle

beats.title: The dip by the drain

event.title: The dip by the drain
event.speaker: physio
setup: A season on. The far corner of pitch two, the dip by the drain. You go over on the same ankle, not as bad. Nobody saw.
{if arc.path=='played'}It clicks when you put weight on it. It's clicked since last season.{/if}

outcomes.text: {physio.short} looks at it and then out of the window at the drain. That afternoon she rings the groundsman about the dip, and he fills it in.
You run it off. It holds. In the shower it's purple and you put your sock on before anyone sees.

beats.hint: A season on, the far corner of pitch two
